payload.description_html: Originally thought to be an iguanodontid, Muttaburrasaurus has been reclassified as an elasmarian. This fully bipedal group of ornithopod dinosaurs sits outside the iguanodontia, lacking the characteristic dental batteries. This classification makes Muttaburrasaurus the largest elasmarian dinosaur at approximately 8 m in length, and weighing around 3 t.
